about_the_game:
Alieno's Revitalized Playable Grime Collection, a tale of Sales, Science and Spirits...

Soon, you will be able to experience three classic RPGMAKER2003 games in new and improved forms!

The games are:

  • Norman Jones Selling Extravaganza [Employee Of The Month Edition]

  • Professor Frippel's Special Invention Show - PEER REVIEWED

  • Miodesopsia

These games come featuring huge improvements in collaboration with PsychoAlpaca, co-creator of Norman Jones, and Michael, programmer and creator of the Zero Point Games Studio and Zero Point Survivor (available on Steam now!). You will see tons of new areas, obstacles, characters and enemies, as well as an incredibly thorough process of polishing and bugfixing. The three games will be packaged into one launcher, with tons of extra stuff!

Also experience the endless runner minigame "Trapped In Time", and tons of extras in the featured playable launcher!

-----

How it works

Upon starting this game, you will open up the Launcher, an interactable world set in some public toilets where the Assistant Director has done some business.

Click on the clock on the wall to access "Trapped In Time", an endless runner minigame, and click on the three doors to access three different RPGs.

Norman Jones is a salesman sent to a remote, rural village, where he is tasked with selling vacuum cleaners to earn his Boss's promotion! "Fight" and explore these lands and their mysteries...

Professor Frippel is a scientist with a new invention to showcase! When it backfires, all scientists in town are turned into mice! And they've ended up on a strange alien planet. They will be battling their way through 3 areas or dungeon, and get together parts to fix their ship! What mysteries await them?

Miodesopsia is an experimental, alternative exploration game, where fights are replaced with talking. You explore the last few minutes of a spirit before it is sent for judgement by a being which calls herself "The Archon". Collect souls, and pave your own path...

content_descriptors.notes:
Norman Jones contains mild themes, mild imagery, mild innuendo and tobacco use.

Professor Frippel contains mild depictions of bullying.

Miodesopsia contains occasionally intense themes, occasional body horror and unsettling imagery including that of insects.

All games contain occasional course language and toilet humor. May contain flashing imagery.

short_description: Play 3 RPG Maker 2003 games remastered and upgraded for 2025! "Norman Jones' Selling Extravaganza", "Professor Frippel's Special Invention Show", and "Miodesopsia". Also comes with extra features! Like an interactive launcher, a concept art folder, and a runner minigame: "Trapped in Time"!
